name: ew-obsidian-knowledge-forge
description: Turn ChatGPT conversations and generated documents into a one-click Obsidian knowledge package.

interface.displayName: EW Embodied Knowledge Forge / 具象知識鍛造器
interface.shortDescription: Chat to a one-click Obsidian package / 聊完即產生 Obsidian 知識包。
interface.longDescription: EW Embodied Knowledge Forge turns ChatGPT conversations and generated documents into linked, versioned Markdown delivered as one .ewforge package. 具象知識鍛造器會自動整理聊天與生成文件、建立標籤、版本、索引與雙向關聯，使用者不必設定 API 金鑰或理解 YAML。
defaultPrompt: Turn this conversation into an EW Knowledge Package for Obsidian.
Format these generated documents and export them to Obsidian.
Link this new material to an existing topic and create an incremental package.
把這段聊天整理成 EW 知識包。
把這些生成文件格式化並匯出給 Obsidian。
將新內容連結到既有主題後產生增量知識包。
